images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. New wide 3:2 lifestyle photograph for fictional MUMBO JUMBO stationery advertising. A closed pocket notebook on the table has the established stacked heavy black 'MUMBO JUMBO' wordmark and small red ink dot, with no other text. Modest lived-in cafe, no other readable brands.
